resolution: User's stress test falsified my linear FPS model: 54.9M tris at GPU 3.1ms (was 24.9M at 3.2ms). Explained from render architecture: the frame was fill/overhead-bound, not primitive-bound — pixels shaded are screen-capped (early-Z), distant sub-pixel triangles are rejected at fixed-function rate, so the per-triangle GPU term is still <0.5ms at 55M tris. Card is absorbing 13.2G submitted tris/sec. Revised walls in arrival order: (1) stroke-regen hitch, already visible as apptick jsTick=63.2ms, scales linearly with painted area; (2) user's 750MB-1GB RAM line at ~8-16x current paint (bush already 192MiB CPU + 192MiB GPU slim pool); (3) fps wall pushed out to ~1-1.5B tris, photo-finishing with the maxBufferSize hard wall (~2-4B). Told user GPU-ms slope is the tell for entering the triangle-bound regime. Answer only, no code changed.
